_about: Speed budgets checked by tests/test-speed.js (Mid Android: Chromium Pixel 7, CPU 4x, Fast 4G). Source: tests/perf/BASELINE.md 'Proposed budgets'. kind=bytes budgets are exact; kind=time and kind=memory fail only when the median of 3 runs (memory: one run) is more than 10% over budget.

warm.label: warm
warm.how: Second visit, service worker installed: navigation start to the first tap (Today tab) painted after the app is ready. Median of 3.

cold.label: cold
cold.how: New profile, empty cache, gzip server: navigation start to the first tap painted. Median of 3.

loadTask.label: loadTask
loadTask.how: Longest task (Long Tasks API) during the cold load, up to 500 ms after usable. Median of 3.

gzip.label: gzip
gzip.how: index.html gzip level 6 (like GitHub Pages), computed from the file. Budget 350 KB.

firstVisit.label: 1stVisit
firstVisit.how: All response bytes the gzip server sends on a first visit, including the service worker install, until requests are quiet. Budget 400 KB.

warmBg.label: warmBg
warmBg.how: All response bytes on a warm launch, including the background refresh and the version check (waits 7 s). Budget 5 KB.

tap.label: tap
tap.how: Simple taps (exercise sheet open/close, Search, Progress Muscles, Today, Profile, Backup tab, session next x2): worst tap per run, median of 3 runs. Tap = pointerdown to next paint after handlers.

exercises.label: exercises
exercises.how: Open Exercises tab the first time. Median of 3.

progress.label: progress
progress.how: Open Progress tab (seed data). Median of 3.

restore.label: restore
restore.how: Profile, Backup: Restore the current code (seed data). Median of 3.

meal.label: meal
meal.how: Search & log: type '2 eggs and a bowl of oatmeal', Enter (first meal of the page load), key to next paint. Median of 3.

progress10x.label: progress10x
progress10x.how: Open Progress with 10x data (about 10 months). Median of 3.

backup10x.label: backup10x
backup10x.how: Profile: Backup tab with 10x data. Median of 3.

search100x.label: search100x
search100x.how: Search & log typing 'squat' with 100x data (state over the storage quota, loaded via __ISOHOLD_STATE): worst key per run, median of 3.

progress100x.label: progress100x
progress100x.how: Open Progress with 100x data (about 8 years). Median of 3.

ai.label: ai
ai.how: Coach question with mocked streaming Gemini: Enter to first words painted, minus the measured first-byte delay (600 ms mock). Median of 3.

aiPaint.label: aiPaint
aiPaint.how: Same run: first byte to first words painted. Median of 3.

heap.label: heap
heap.how: JS heap after GC at the end of a short scripted loop (scaled stand-in for the 10-minute session; see the loop count in the output).

heapGrowth.label: heapGrowth
heapGrowth.how: JS heap after GC: end of the loop minus after the first 2 warm-up loops (stand-in for 'growth after the first minute').

dom.label: dom
dom.how: Elements in the document at the end of the loop.
